attempts.summary: Configured PostgreSQL 16 streaming replication across the cluster: node1 as writable primary, node2 and node3 as read-only physical standbys using pg_basebackup, replication slots, and a SCRAM-authenticated replicator role. Verified writes on node1 propagate to both standbys and that standbys reject writes. Completed the mandatory node-restart evidence protocol for all three nodes (standbys first, primary last), confirming changed boot IDs and full post-restart recovery of PostgreSQL, replication streaming, and data.
